name: When do I need professional water damage restoration for a toilet overflow?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional water damage restoration for a toilet overflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional water damage restoration is needed if the overflow is extensive, involves contaminated water (Category 2 or 3), or if the water has seeped into structural components like drywall, flooring, or subflooring. Even seemingly small overflows can lead to hidden moisture and mold if not dried properly. If you suspect moisture has penetrated beyond the surface, or if you're unsure about the extent of the damage, it's safer to call in experts to assess and mitigate the situation thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional restoration is needed for extensive overflows, contaminated water, or when water has seeped into structural elements. Experts can prevent hidden moisture and mold.
